captions.detailed: This 3D model features a slender, curved hairband designed to fit comfortably around a head. The main band has a smooth, semi-circular profile with rounded outer edges, giving it a soft, C-shaped cross-section. At each open end of the hairband, there is a small, flat square tab (brim) attached to the bottom, which serves as a temporary support structure for stable 3D printing.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable hairband in OpenSCAD with an adjustable inner diameter, height, band width, and thickness. It should feature a rounded outer curvature for comfort, a symmetric two-part design, and an optional flat brim at the tips to aid bed adhesion during printing.
captions.factory: The code constructs a symmetric hairband by mirroring a 'semi_band' module. The 'semi_band' uses a 'shap_ring' module which generates the curved cross-section using 'rotate_extrude' of an intersected 'circle' and 'square'. It utilizes 'linear_extrude' with 'polygon' masks to trim the ring segments at specific angles, and includes a conditional flat 'cube' as a partial brim at the tips for print adhesion.
